name: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite

It offers high-performance reasoning, complex instruction following, and deep contextual understanding for a wide range of tasks across language, analysis, and problem solving.

name: Google Gemini 3.1 Pro
description: Gemini 3.1 Pro is Google’s flagship multimodal language model that processes text alongside images, audio, video, code, and documents. It offers high-performance reasoning, complex instruction following, and deep contextual understanding for a wide range of tasks across language, analysis, and problem solving.

name: MiniMax-M2.7
description: MiniMax M2.7‑Highspeed is the performance‑tuned variant of M2.7, built for lower latency and higher throughput while keeping output behavior consistent with the standard model. It’s a strong fit for interactive coding agents, tool‑calling pipelines, and office automation flows where responsiveness matters.

name: MiniMax-M2.7
description: MiniMax M2.7 is a long‑context LLM designed for agentic workflows across software engineering, search and tool use, and high‑value office productivity tasks. It’s built for multi‑step execution, with strong instruction following and dependable task decomposition, making it a solid default for production assistants that write code, call tools, and handle complex document workflows.

name: Google Gemini 3 Flash
description: Gemini 3 Flash is Google’s flagship multimodal language model that processes text alongside images, audio, video, code, and documents. It offers high-performance reasoning, complex instruction following, and deep contextual understanding for a wide range of tasks across language, analysis, and problem solving.

name: GPT-5.4 Mini
description: GPT-5.4 Mini is a compact, efficient variant of GPT-5.4 designed for coding assistants, subagent orchestration, and multimodal applications requiring faster responsiveness. It supports a 400K token context window and retains native computer use and configurable reasoning effort at a lower cost than the flagship model.

name: GPT-5.4 Nano
description: GPT-5.4 Nano is the smallest and fastest variant of GPT-5.4, designed for high-throughput, low-latency tasks such as classification, data extraction, ranking, and lightweight automation. It prioritizes speed and cost efficiency for simple, high-volume workloads and is available exclusively via the API.

name: GLM-5.1
description: GLM-5.1 is Z.ai’s flagship language model for agentic engineering, coding, reasoning, and tool-driven workflows. It supports a 200K token context window with up to 128K output tokens, deep thinking, function calling, structured output, and streaming tool calls, and is designed to stay effective over long multi-step sessions rather than only short-horizon tasks.

name: Claude Opus 4.7
description: Frontier multimodal reasoning model for advanced coding, long-running agents, and complex knowledge work

name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
description: Claude Sonnet 4.6 is Anthropic's most capable Sonnet model, built for daily production use across coding, agent workflows, long-context reasoning, computer use, and professional knowledge work. It supports adaptive and extended thinking, strong instruction following, high-volume automation, and a 1M-token context window in beta.

name: Claude Haiku 4.5
description: Claude Haiku 4.5 is Anthropic's fastest and most cost-efficient Claude model. It is built for latency-sensitive applications, high-volume agents, sub-agent orchestration, coding assistance, and budget-conscious deployments that still need strong reasoning and multimodal understanding.

name: moonshotai-kimi-k2-6
description: Kimi K2.6 - Moonshot AI open-source MoE model with optional reasoning, served via DeepInfra (OpenAI-compatible).

name: google-gemma-4-31b
description: Google Gemma 4 31B - open-weight 31B multimodal LLM with thinking mode (off/high), function calling, JSON output, vision/video inputs, and 262K context. Served via vLLM (OpenAI-compatible).

name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash
description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash is DeepSeek's fast, efficient, and cost-focused frontier language model for coding, reasoning, and agent workflows. It supports both thinking and non-thinking modes, a 1M token context window, up to 384K output tokens, tool calls, JSON output, and efficient long-context operation for software, research, and structured professional tasks.

name: google-gemini-3-5-flash
description: Gemini 3.5 Flash is Google's fast multimodal language model with strong agentic capabilities (near-Pro level). Processes text, images, audio, video, code, and documents. Returns text. Optimised for speed and value for production agent workloads.

name: Grok 4.3
description: Grok 4.3 is xAI's flagship language model for agentic reasoning, strong instruction following, and minimal hallucinations. It supports text and image input, a 1 million token context window, configurable reasoning effort including non-reasoning mode, function calling, and structured outputs for production assistants, coding workflows, and long-context analysis.

name: Claude Opus 4.8
description: Claude Opus 4.8 is Anthropic's highest-capability Claude model. It is built for demanding coding, agent orchestration, multimodal reasoning, and professional workflows that need strong instruction following, adaptive and extended thinking, high-resolution vision, and a 1M-token context window.

name: MiniMax M3
description: MiniMax M3 is MiniMax's new flagship open-weight model for coding, agentic execution, and multimodal reasoning. It is built around the MiniMax Sparse Attention architecture, supports up to 1 million tokens of context, accepts image and video input in addition to text, and is designed for long-running software, research, browsing, and desktop-operation workflows that need strong tool use and sustained multi-step performance.

name: anthropic-claude-fable-5
description: Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's highest-capability publicly available Claude model. It is built for demanding coding, agent orchestration, multimodal reasoning, and professional workflows that need strong instruction following, adaptive and extended thinking, high-resolution vision, tool use, and a 1M-token context window.

name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro
description: DeepSeek-V4-Pro is DeepSeek's flagship V4 language model for coding, reasoning, and agent workflows that need stronger overall capability than the Flash variant. It supports both thinking and non-thinking modes, a 1M token context window, up to 384K output tokens, tool calls, JSON output, and long-context operation for demanding software, research, and structured professional workloads.

name: GPT-5 Mini
description: GPT-5 Mini is a faster, more cost-efficient variant of GPT-5 designed for well-defined tasks, precise prompts, and high-volume production use. OpenAI positions it for cost-sensitive, low-latency workloads while retaining strong reasoning ability, 400K context, 128K max output tokens, image input support, and compatibility with structured outputs and function calling.

name: GPT-5 Nano
description: GPT-5 Nano is OpenAI's fastest and cheapest GPT-5 variant, built for speed- and cost-sensitive workloads such as summarization, classification, extraction, and lightweight automation. It supports 400K context, 128K max output tokens, image input, reasoning token support, structured outputs, and function calling in a compact package optimized for high-throughput API use.

name: openai-gpt-5-1
description: GPT-5.1 is OpenAI's flagship reasoning-capable general-purpose model on the OpenAI Responses API, offered through Runware's passthrough. It supports adjustable reasoning effort, function calling, and multimodal input.

name: GLM-5.2
description: GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's flagship language model for long-horizon coding, agentic engineering, and sustained multi-step execution. It is designed to keep large project context coherent over extended runs, with a 1M token context window, 128K max output, multiple thinking modes, function calling, structured output, context caching, streaming, and MCP support for tool-rich workflows.

name: openai-gpt-oss-120b
description: gpt-oss-120b is OpenAI's open-weight (Apache 2.0) flagship reasoning model: a 117B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts that activates ~5.1B parameters per token. Built for high-reasoning, agentic, and general-purpose production use, it offers a 131K-token context window, configurable reasoning effort (low/medium/high) with full chain-of-thought access, native tool use with function calling and structured output, and strong math, coding, and long-context performance rivalling o4-mini. Trained with reinforcement learning informed by OpenAI's frontier systems.

name: qwen3.5-9b
description: Qwen3.5-9B is a 9-billion-parameter open-weight model from Alibaba, self-hosted on Runware infrastructure and served over an OpenAI-compatible API. It accepts multimodal input (text and images) with a 262,144-token context window, and supports both thinking (chain-of-thought) and non-thinking modes, tool/function calling, and structured outputs.

name: qwen3.5-4b
description: Qwen3.5-4B is a 4-billion-parameter open-weight model from Alibaba, self-hosted on Runware infrastructure and served over an OpenAI-compatible API. It is the most cost-efficient member of the Qwen 3.5 line, accepting multimodal input (text and images) with a 262,144-token context window, and supports both thinking (chain-of-thought) and non-thinking modes, tool/function calling, and structured outputs.

name: moonshotai-kimi-k3
description:
Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI's flagship agentic model: a 2.8T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts activating 104B parameters per token (16 of 896 experts across 93 layers). It is natively         
  multimodal across text, images and video via the 401M-parameter MoonViT-V2 encoder, and carries a 1,048,576-token context window. Built for long-horizon agentic work — knowledge tasks, research and automation — with  
  native reasoning at adjustable thinking effort (low/high/max), tool calling, and structured output.

name: google-gemini-3-6-flash
description: Gemini 3.6 Flash is Google's latest Flash model, balancing speed with intelligence. Multimodal input (text, images, audio, video, code, documents) with a 1,048,576-token context window and up to 65,536 output tokens. Served over Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint and forwarded verbatim.

name: google-gemini-3-5-flash-lite
description: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is Google's fastest, most cost-effective 3.5 model, built for high-throughput execution. Multimodal input with a 1,048,576-token context window and up to 65,536 output tokens. Served over Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint and forwarded verbatim.

name: zai-glm-5-2-0
description: GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's flagship language model for long-horizon coding, agentic engineering, and sustained multi-step execution. name: google-gemini-3-7-flash

Multimodal input (text, images, audio, video, code, documents) with a 1,048,576-token context window and up to 65,536 output tokens. Served over Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

name: zai-glm-5-3-flash
description: GLM-5.3-Flash is Z.ai's lower-cost multimodal model for coding, long-horizon agent workflows, and visual reasoning. It is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, combining text, image and video understanding with stronger coding and agent performance, and is positioned as a default model for frequent professional work that needs fast feedback and efficient long-context serving.

name: zai-glm-5-3
description: GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's flagship language model for coding, tool-using agents, and sustained multi-step problem solving. It builds on the long-horizon engineering focus of the recent GLM line with stronger software engineering performance, better benchmark results across terminal and agent evaluations, and notably stronger capability in security-oriented code analysis and vulnerability discovery. It is a strong fit for demanding coding assistants, automation systems, and engineering workflows that need reliable reasoning over large task context.

name: google-gemini-3-8-flash
description: Gemini 3.8 Flash is Google's most capable Flash model, with substantial improvements across software engineering, web development, and agentic workflows. Multimodal input (text, images, audio, video, code, documents) with a 1,048,576-token context window and up to 65,536 output tokens. Served over Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

name: anthropic-claude-opus-5
description: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's highest-capability Claude model. It is built for demanding coding, agent orchestration, multimodal reasoning, and professional workflows that need strong instruction following, adaptive and extended thinking, high-resolution vision, and a 1M-token context window.

name: deepseek-v4-1-flash
description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model for coding, reasoning, visual understanding, and tool-using agents. It processes text and images, generates text, and combines a 1M-token context window with continuously adjustable reasoning effort. Its Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture, sparse attention, and compressed KV cache reduce the memory and computation required for long inputs, making it well suited to large-codebase work, document analysis, research, and sustained agentic tasks.

name: anthropic-claude-fable-5-1
description: Claude Fable 5.1 is Anthropic's model for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. It supports text and image input, adaptive thinking that is always on, tool use, a 1M-token context window and up to 128K output tokens. Served on the Anthropic Messages API.

name: anthropic-claude-opus-5-5

name: anthropic-claude-sonnet-5
